jobs.title: Graduate Town Planner
jobs.description:
Graduate Planner

Macclesfield Competitive salary Full training and professional development

Are you a recent graduate looking to build a career in town planning?

Were currently working with an established and growing planning consultancy that is looking to appoint a Graduate Planner to join its team in Macclesfield.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent planning graduate to gain hands:on experience across a broad range of projects, working alongside experienced planning professionals and developing the skills needed to progress within the industry.

The Role

As a Graduate Planner, youll support the planning team across a variety of projects, gaining exposure to the full planning process and developing your professional knowledge.

Youll have the opportunity to work on a range of planning applications and projects while receiving support and guidance from experienced colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Assisting with the preparation and submission of planning applications.
Supporting planning research and site appraisals.
Reviewing local planning policies and planning documents.
Undertaking research into planning history and relevant legislation.
Assisting with planning statements, reports and other project documentation.
Communicating with clients, local authorities and other stakeholders.
Monitoring planning applications and providing updates to clients.
Supporting senior planners with a variety of residential, commercial and other development projects.
Keeping up to date with changes to planning policy and legislation.
Developing your professional knowledge and progressing towards becoming a fully qualified planning professional.

Requirements

Were looking for a motivated graduate who is keen to establish a long:term career within planning.

Ideally, Youll Have

A degree in Town Planning, Planning and Development or a closely related subject.
A genuine interest in the planning and development sector.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Excellent research and analytical abilities.
Good organisation and attention to detail.
The ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Confidence using Microsoft Office.
A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

Previous planning experience, including internships or placement experience, would be beneficial but is not essential.

Whats on Offer?

Competitive graduate salary.
Full training and support from experienced planning professionals.
Exposure to a diverse range of planning projects.
Excellent opportunity to develop your planning career.
Support towards relevant professional development and progression.
Friendly and collaborative working environment.
Opportunity to gain valuable consultancy experience in a growing planning business.
Macclesfield:based role.

This is a great opportunity for a planning graduate looking for their first step into consultancy and wanting to develop their career within an experienced and supportive team.

Interested?

For more information, or to discuss the opportunity confidentially, please contact:

Efan Thomas

Job Title: Senior Town Planner

Ref: BM336

Location: Macclesfield

Salary: GBP45,000 : GBP55,000

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established independent town planning consultancy who provide a range of expertise to the residential, commercial, and mixed:use sectors. They are on the lookout for an experienced and enthusiastic Senior Town Planner to hit the ground running for their Macclesfield office.

Benefits For The Role Of Senior Town Planner Include

Highly competitive salary
Contributory pension scheme
Generous holiday allowance
Professional development
Personal development

Duties For The Role Of Senior Town Planner

Managing a portfolio of planning projects from initial appraisal through to determination.
Preparing and coordinating planning applications and supporting documentation.
Providing strategic planning advice to clients and development teams.
Undertaking site appraisals and assessing development potential.
Preparing planning statements, representations and other planning documentation.
Managing planning appeals and negotiations with local planning authorities.
Liaising with planning officers, statutory consultees, consultants and other stakeholders.
Supporting clients with development promotion and Local Plan matters.

Requirements For The Role Of Senior Town Planner

A degree or postgraduate qualification in Town Planning or a related discipline.
MRTPI Chartered status
Significant experience within a planning consultancy, local authority or related planning environment.
Strong knowledge of the UK planning system and relevant planning policy.
Experience preparing and managing planning applications.
Experience dealing with planning authorities and negotiating planning matters.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organisational and project management abilities.
The confidence to deal directly with clients and professional teams.
A proactive, pragmatic and solutions:focused approach.
The ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant
jobs.description:
Department:
Product
Location:
Melville, NY
Compensation:
$130,000 - $140,000 / year

Description

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Solutions Consultant who loves solving real business problems with technology. In this role you’ll be the bridge between what retailers need and what our unified commerce platform can do—guiding prospects, clients, and partners from first conversation through successful adoption.

You’ll lead tailored product demonstrations, translate business requirements into practical solutions, and help clients get the most out of the platform after they sign. You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Client Delivery, and Customer Success, and you’ll need a balance of deep product knowledge, retail savvy, and the communication skills to make complex things clear to both technical and non-technical audiences.

As a Solutions Consultant, you excel at the following core competencies
Problem Solving –
Translates business problems into clear, practical solutions that fit real-world constraints of timeline, budget, and platform capabilities.
Retail Acumen –
Understands retail operations deeply enough to anticipate downstream impacts on stores, staff, and customers.
Communication –
Explains complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, from store associates to executives.
Systems Thinking –
Thinks systematically about data flows, integrations, and system dependencies across the commerce stack.
Comfort with Ambiguity –
Operates confidently during discovery, asking clarifying questions to avoid assumptions and uncover the real requirement.
Continuous Learning –
Learns quickly, picks up new capabilities fast, and turns lessons into reusable knowledge for the team.

The impact you'll make

Pre-Sales Solutioning
Lead product demonstrations tailored to each prospect’s business needs and use cases.
Run discovery sessions to understand business requirements, then translate them into solutions using KWI’s functional capabilities and standard integration methods.
Create solution documentation and support RFP responses that show how KWI addresses specific business challenges.

Post-Sales Implementation Support
Help clients configure and optimize KWI to solve their business problems, guiding process and workflow changes and supporting change management.
Resolve complex implementation challenges and guide clients on connecting KWI to third-party systems using standard integration methods.
Document solutions and best practices for reuse, partner with Client Delivery on challenging implementations, and advocate for platform enhancements when client needs exceed current capabilities.

Partner Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Develop frameworks, best practices, and enablement materials that help implementation and referral partners position KWI, and provide solutioning guidance in their engagements.
Work with Product and Customer Success to turn client challenges into product requirements and reusable solution patterns, and share market insights that inform product strategy.

What you will bring

3–5 years of experience in a solutions consulting, sales engineering, implementation, or pre-sales role—ideally in retail technology, commerce, or B2B enterprise SaaS.
A working understanding of retail operations (point of sale, merchandising, order management, or CRM) and how they connect.
The ability to lead compelling product demonstrations and tailor them to a specific audience and use case.
Experience gathering requirements, designing solutions, and documenting them clearly for technical and business stakeholders.
Familiarity with integrations, APIs, and data flows between systems, and the judgment to recommend practical approaches.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with comfort working across Sales, Product, and Client Delivery teams.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a bias toward learning quickly in a fast-paced environment.

As a member of the KWI team you will receive

Full Medical, Dental and Vision
Annual bonus eligible
Free gym in the building
Generous PTO policy
Summer Fridays....all year round
Tuition Reimbursement
Discount from building café
401(K) with a 50% company match (up to 6% of employee contribution)
Employee Referral Program
(1) Volunteer day each year

Our work space

We understand that our teams need flexibility, which is why we follow a hybrid schedule. Our in-office days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and employees are allowed to work remotely on Wednesdays and Friday.

We are also a collaborative group and believe that getting together in person allows our team to do their best work. Together we enjoy monthly events, bagels every Thursday, a full snack pantry and many more surprise and delight moments throughout the year.

Our commitment to you

At KWI, we know that cultivating diversity and fostering an inclusive work environment is critical to our impact and success. We create an environment where no individual is advantaged or disadvantaged because of their background. We offer equal opportunity employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, marital status, or protected veteran status.

With a commitment to maintaining a bias-free environment in which harassment is prohibited, we respect cultural diversity and comply with the laws of the places in which we operate. We expect our business partners, suppliers, clients, and all our team members to uphold these commitments.

jobs.title: Major Customer Success Mgr
jobs.description:
Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.

With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.

_________________________________________________________

About The Role

The Major Customer Success Manager - Uniti is responsible for establishing and building customer relationships and promoting customer adoption of our products & solutions.

What You'll Do

The Major Customer Success Manager assures us customers are satisfied with services and are realizing the value of their investment in Uniti. The role proactively engages customers to provide product and feature updates, helps customers increase usage of product features, facilitates product training, and identifies opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships based on real-time insights into customer needs.

The Major Customer Success Manager also orchestrates issue resolution on behalf of the customer and is often the primary point of contact working with other teams behind the scenes to deliver on the customer’s promise. The Major Customer Success Manager will play a key role in migrating customers to advanced access methods and driving increased uptake of SDWan and UCaaS through a solution focused mindset based on a deep understanding of a customer's unique technical requirements and needs. The Major Customer Success Manager will partner closely with Enterprise Sales Executives within their shared geographic region.

The joint Sales and Customer Success team will co-develop customer plans and prioritize opportunities. Key aspects of the role include:

Proactively engage Elite and Enterprise accounts and develop compelling solution use-cases.
Execute customer check-in schedules to ensure the right solutions are top of mind.
Collaborate with Sales Executives on defining the strategy and vision for key customers.
Build a deep understanding of customer needs and challenges and how Windstream's products can add value to the customer.
Nurture and support customers through regular proactive engagement
Conduct regular customer check-ins to build trust, introduce products and features, intervene where there are issues, and consistently achieve high customer satisfaction.
Articulate compelling product opportunities based on a deep real-time knowledge of the customer technical environment and unique issues.
Initiate opportunities and partner closely with Sales to ensure the Sales Executive is appropriately positioning such opportunities to drive tangible business value for the customer.
Partner with Elite Care and Service Delivery to prioritize issues.
Address the root cause of problems to improve the customer experience.
Monitor customer health indicators and build personal relationships with customer stakeholders to flag and preempt issues before they put the customer relationship at-risk.
Partner with Access Ops teams to prioritize advanced access conversions.
Build logical product progression perspectives to ensure high rates of migration to advanced access and uptake of strategic products.
Increase customer awareness of the benefits of conversions and facilitate the customer journey through the migration process.
Provide product training to customer users and address issues that limit the number of users while monitoring customer satisfaction.
Deliver on core Customer Success business KPIs.
Drive high feature adoption and product usage.
Deliver against time-to-first value targets.
Drive high customer health scores.
Maximize customer lifetime value and consistently translate customer knowledge into opportunities to deepen and expand the customer relationship.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have

Customer relationship skills and a solution focus
Experience in expanding adoption at enterprise customers
Understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models
Understanding of the SD-WAN and UCaaS product suites and roadmap
Data and technology orientation
Technical ability to speak to customers.
Cross-disciplinary collaboration skills

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree and 9+ years professional level related experience or an equivalent combination of education and professional related experience.
3-4 years customer relationship management experience
Experience in the technology or telecom sectors
Track record of cross-disciplinary team collaboration, influencing and effective stakeholder management
Ability to build compelling product use cases.
Ability to effectively resolve complexity and overcome roadblocks to achieve tangible outcomes.

Desired Qualifications

Engineering or Business Degree with 5+ years of related experience.

_________________________________________________________

Our Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Plans
401K Plan
Health & Flexible Savings Account
Life and AD&D, Spousal Life, Child Life Insurance Plans
Educational Assistance Plan

Uniti is an equal opportunity employer. At Uniti, we celebrate the authenticity and uniqueness of our people and their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, genetic information, protected veteran status, current military status, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, creed, citizenship status, or any other status protected by law, and to give full consideration to qualified disabled individuals and protected veterans.

Actual base pay for this job will depend on the candidate's primary work location and other factors, such as relevant skills and experience.

Notice to Non-U.S. Citizens:Uniti, as a holder of licenses granted by the Federal Communications Commission, is required to notify and to obtain approval from federal regulatory agencies prior to granting certain system/network access to any non-U.S. citizen personnel. Offers of employment extended to non-U.S. citizens are contingent upon receiving the requisite approval from agencies overseeing compliance. Non-U.S. citizens are required to provide Uniti with the personal identifying information required to obtain the necessary approval prior to accessing certain systems and/or Uniti’s network. If you are not a U.S. citizen, please notify your recruiter or contact HR Legal as soon as possible for information on Uniti’s foreign personnel disclosure and approval requirements.

Notice to Applicants: Depending on the position and its job functions, offers of employment may be contingent upon successful completion of certain pre-employment screenings, including but not limited to drug-screen, motor vehicle records check, or other pre-employment screening. All such screenings will be conducted by an external third-party with the Candidate’s written consent and in accordance with federal and state law. Refusal to authorize or submit to a required pre-employment screening may disqualify the candidate from employment. Any misrepresentation during the application or interview process may result in denial of employment, withdrawal of offer, or termination.
